competency.title: Compare visual perception — worked example
competency.outcome: Compare two plausible methods for visual perception using an image-to-object inventory. Use a small, fully specified worked case and then change one input.
competency.practice_task: Produce a paired comparison and tradeoff table grounded in an image-to-object inventory.
competency.setting_constraint: Use a small, fully specified worked case and then change one input.
required_evidence: a paired comparison and tradeoff table
Include the solved case and the changed-case prediction.
Report detection precision and missed objects with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: hallucinating occluded detail.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of visual perception.
Practice: same inputs and budgets yield a justified choice.
Measurement: report detection precision and missed objects against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for hallucinating occluded detail; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
